summary.answer: Creates Loading_WZ_Splitscreen, initializes loading-fraction updates, owner and menu-open sound, then builds backgrounds, loadbar, XP icons, aspect-ratio fix, PC notification child and trial banner. The non-nil loaded-fraction callback changes the exact loadbar shader. menu_loaded is processed before close registration and optional PostLoadFunc, then self is returned. The PC_Notif_Container.new request, self:addElement request and self.PCNotifContainer field store at56–58 are unconditional if reached; only its id assignment at64–65 is guarded by CoD.isPC. There is no fake PC child substitution in this selected factory.
